area.tripRules: Trips can be booked up to five days in advance and can go between any two places in town.

Lawrence.serviceHours: Day: 8 a.m. - 6 p.m., Sunday. Night: 8 p.m. - 6 a.m., Monday - Saturday. Night: 12 a.m. - 6 a.m., Sunday. No daytime service Monday to Saturday.
Lawrence.hoursNote: Sunday is left out because the page's Sunday 12 a.m. - 6 a.m. night window is unclear: it may mean early Sunday (already covered by Saturday night) or the night running into Monday. The page lists no holiday hours.

notes: The zone is the City of Lawrence city limit (CORPORATE='Lawrence', OBJECTID 8), used as a proxy because the agency says the service runs within the city limits and publishes no zone map. Re-check if the city limit changes or the agency publishes GTFS-Flex. Sunday hours need confirming with the agency before Sunday can be encoded.
